note: Southampton County VA publishes no queryable zoning district polygons. The Hampton Roads Locality_Zones layer has a Zoning_Southampton entry whose only record reads 'Currently unavailable'. The county's zoning is published as Municode text only. The county iGIS portal is a login viewer with no public REST services (probe returned 404). Boykins relies on a 1966 paper zoning map; Capron and Courtland have no published zoning text or maps. The third-party Zoneomics map and parcel vendors are not official or queryable.
